title: Test imitation only after an observable expert is validated
doing: Keep behaviour cloning/DAgger plus PPO as a separately gated comparison against matched PPO, two training seeds per arm. First validate an expert that uses only teacher observations. The original FullState heuristic fails that equal-information gate; privileged-label distillation would need a separate explicit proposal. No demonstration collection, replay or training is authorized.
expected: An observable short-horizon expert may supply useful action supervision cheaply and improve early survival, but imitation can inherit model errors or plateau at the expert. Information aliasing can prevent matching a fuller-state heuristic; its historical performance is not an attainable guarantee.

evidence.label: User priority-order steer, reviewed with current local evidence
